name: MDF Heart Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Beautiful laser-cut heart shape crafted from 3mm MDF. Perfect for DIY craft projects, scrapbooking, wedding decorations, or personalized gifts. Smooth edges and lightweight design make this cutout easy to paint, stain, or decorate. Approximate size: 8cm x 8cm.

name: MDF Star Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Five-pointed star cutout precision-cut from 3mm MDF using advanced laser technology. Ideal for wall art, party decorations, and children's craft activities. The smooth sanded surface accepts paint, glitter, and markers beautifully. Approximate size: 7cm x 7cm.

name: MDF Butterfly Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Elegant butterfly silhouette laser-cut from premium 3mm MDF. This delicate cutout features intricate wing detail perfect for scrapbooking, card making, and home decor projects. Easy to paint and customize. Approximate size: 10cm x 8cm.

name: MDF Elephant Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Charming 2D flat elephant cutout silhouette precision-cut from premium 3mm MDF, offered in two finishes: Raw MDF (ready for paint, markers, and DIY craft kits) and White Finish (Bright White Coloring Canvas, perfect for standard crayons and markers). This design is highly optimized and easy to cut on any CO2 laser machine and is ideal for nursery decor, children's educational play, DIY craft projects, wedding themes, and personalized gifts. The clean laser-cut edges ensure a smooth, professional finish. Available in two sizes: 4.8cm x 4.8cm and 9.6cm x 9.6cm, 3mm thickness.

details.material: Premium MDF / Pre-bonded Matte Paper Layer

name: MDF Circle Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Perfectly round circle cutout made from 3mm MDF with smooth laser-cut edges. A versatile craft essential for coasters, ornaments, monogram bases, and mixed media art. Takes acrylic paint and wood stain exceptionally well. Approximate size: 10cm diameter.

name: MDF Cat Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Adorable cat silhouette cutout crafted from 3mm MDF with precision laser cutting. Perfect for pet lovers, nursery wall art, and creative craft projects. Smooth surface ready for painting or decoupage. Approximate size: 9cm x 11cm.

name: MDF Diamond Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Geometric diamond shape laser-cut from 3mm MDF. This modern cutout is perfect for geometric wall art, jewelry making, and contemporary craft projects. Clean lines and smooth edges straight from the laser. Approximate size: 7cm x 10cm.

name: MDF Bunny Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Sweet bunny rabbit silhouette precision-cut from 3mm MDF. Ideal for Easter decorations, children's room decor, and handmade greeting cards. Laser-cut for consistent quality and smooth finish. Approximate size: 8cm x 12cm.

name: MDF Hexagon Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Trendy hexagonal cutout laser-cut from 3mm MDF. Create stunning geometric wall displays or use as a base for resin art, coasters, and decorative tiles. Precision edges ensure perfect tessellation. Approximate size: 8cm per side.

name: MDF Dog Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Friendly dog silhouette cut from 3mm MDF using precision laser technology. Perfect for pet-themed crafts, keychain blanks, and decorative projects. Paint, stain, or embellish this smooth MDF cutout. Approximate size: 10cm x 10cm.

name: MDF Oval Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Classic oval shape cut from 3mm MDF with smooth laser-cut edges. A versatile blank for frame-making, portrait bases, monogram projects, and vintage-style decor. The smooth surface is ready for any finish. Approximate size: 12cm x 8cm.

name: MDF Fish Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Playful fish silhouette laser-cut from 3mm MDF. Perfect for nautical-themed decor, kids' craft sessions, and ocean-inspired art projects. Smooth edges and flat surface ideal for embellishing. Approximate size: 11cm x 7cm.

name: MDF Triangle Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Equilateral triangle cutout precision-cut from 3mm MDF. Great for geometric art, bunting, mobile making, and educational math projects. Clean laser-cut lines for professional results. Approximate size: 8cm per side.

name: MDF Owl Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Detailed owl silhouette laser-cut from 3mm MDF. This wise little owl features intricate feather details created with precision cutting. Perfect for woodland-themed nurseries and craft projects. Approximate size: 9cm x 12cm.

name: MDF Cross Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Simple cross shape cut from 3mm MDF with laser precision. Ideal for religious crafts, memorial art, church decorations, and personalized gifts. Smooth surface takes paint and embellishments beautifully. Approximate size: 10cm x 10cm.

name: MDF Bird Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Graceful bird in flight silhouette crafted from 3mm MDF with laser cutting. This elegant cutout is perfect for spring decor, nature-themed crafts, and wall art groupings. Lightweight and easy to paint. Approximate size: 10cm x 6cm.

name: MDF Crescent Moon Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Whimsical crescent moon shape laser-cut from 3mm MDF. Perfect for nursery mobiles, celestial-themed decor, and dreamy craft projects. Smooth finish ready for glitter, paint, or resin coating. Approximate size: 9cm x 7cm.

name: MDF Turtle Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Cute sea turtle silhouette cut from 3mm MDF using precision laser technology. This tropical cutout is great for beach-themed decor, kids' craft activities, and ocean conservation projects. Approximate size: 10cm x 8cm.

name: MDF Square Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Perfect square cutout precision-cut from 3mm MDF. An essential craft blank for coasters, picture frame bases, tile mosaics, and pixel art. Laser-cut for exact dimensions and smooth edges. Approximate size: 10cm x 10cm.

name: MDF Lion Cutout – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Majestic lion head silhouette cut from 3mm MDF with laser precision. This regal animal cutout is perfect for safari-themed nurseries, motivational wall art, and kids' craft sessions. Approximate size: 11cm x 11cm.

name: MDF Heart Puzzle Kit – 5 Piece Set
description: Creative heart puzzle kit featuring 5 interlocking MDF pieces laser-cut from 3mm wood. Kids can paint each piece in different colors and assemble into a beautiful heart wall hanging. Includes hanging string and activity guide. Approximate assembled size: 15cm x 15cm.

name: Paint Your Own Animal Faces – MDF Kit
description: Fun paint-your-own kit with 6 animal face cutouts laser-cut from 3mm MDF. Includes lion, bear, cat, owl, elephant, and rabbit faces. Comes with 12 non-toxic paint pots, 2 brushes, and googly eyes. Perfect for parties and craft sessions. Each face approximately 10cm.

name: MDF Star Matching Puzzle – 8 Piece Educational Kit
description: Educational star matching puzzle with 8 laser-cut 3mm MDF star pieces in graduated sizes. Kids learn size sorting, color matching, and fine motor skills. Each star is numbered for counting practice. Safe, smooth edges for little hands.

name: MDF Flower Garden Puzzle – 10 Piece Set
description: Beautiful flower garden puzzle kit with 10 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces including petals, stems, leaves, and a butterfly. Mix and match to create endless garden scenes on the included base board. Great for imaginative play and fine motor development.

name: Paint Your Own Dinosaurs – MDF Kit
description: Roaring fun with this dinosaur painting kit featuring 6 laser-cut 3mm MDF dinosaur silhouettes. Includes T-Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Pterodactyl, Brachiosaurus, and Velociraptor. Comes with 18 paint colors, 3 brushes, and a display stand. Each dino approximately 12cm.

name: MDF Alphabet Puzzle Board – 26 Letter Set
description: Complete alphabet learning kit with 26 laser-cut 3mm MDF letters that fit into a matching puzzle board. Each letter is painted a different color for visual learning. Perfect for preschool education, letter recognition, and early spelling. Board size: 30cm x 20cm.

name: Paint Your Own Unicorn – MDF Craft Kit
description: Magical unicorn painting kit with a large 3mm MDF unicorn cutout ready to be decorated. Laser-cut with detailed mane and horn outlines. Includes glitter paint, 6 acrylic colors, 2 brushes, and adhesive gemstones. Finished unicorn makes a gorgeous room decoration.

name: MDF Geometric Pattern Puzzle – 12 Piece Set
description: Brain-boosting geometric puzzle with 12 laser-cut 3mm MDF shapes including triangles, hexagons, squares, and diamonds. Create tessellations, patterns, and mathematical designs on the included grid board. Develops spatial reasoning and creativity.

name: Paint Your Own Ocean Animals – MDF Kit
description: Dive into creativity with this ocean animal painting kit featuring 8 laser-cut 3mm MDF sea creatures. Includes fish, octopus, dolphin, shark, starfish, seahorse, whale, and crab. Comes with 15 ocean-blue paints, 3 brushes, and an underwater background scene.

name: MDF Space Explorer Puzzle – 10 Piece Set
description: Blast off with this space-themed puzzle kit featuring 10 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces including a rocket, planets, stars, astronaut, and moon. Arrange on the dark blue base board to create your own solar system scene. Educational and fun for aspiring astronauts.

name: MDF Rainbow Color Sorting Kit – 7 Piece Educational Set
description: Vibrant rainbow-themed sorting kit with 7 laser-cut 3mm MDF arches in red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. Stack, nest, and sort by color and size. Perfect for toddler learning, color recognition, and fine motor skill development.

name: MDF Butterfly Garden Puzzle – 8 Piece Set
description: Enchanting butterfly garden puzzle with 8 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces. Features 4 different butterfly designs and 4 flower shapes that can be mixed and matched. Each piece is ready to paint or use pre-colored. Great for nature-themed crafting.

name: Paint Your Own Vehicles – MDF Kit
description: On-the-go creativity with this vehicle painting kit featuring 6 laser-cut 3mm MDF transport silhouettes. Includes car, truck, airplane, helicopter, boat, and train. Comes with 15 bright paints, 3 brushes, and a road scene background. Perfect for little motorists.

name: MDF 3D Butterfly Building Kit – Premium Set
description: Stunning 3D butterfly construction kit with 20 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces. Build realistic three-dimensional butterflies using the interlocking slot design. No glue needed! Includes 3 butterfly templates in different sizes and a display branch. A premium craft experience.

name: MDF 3D Dinosaur Building Kit – Premium Set
description: Epic 3D dinosaur building kit with 25 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces. Construct a T-Rex skeleton using precision-cut interlocking joints. No glue or tools required. Includes illustrated assembly guide and fun dinosaur facts card. Perfect for young paleontologists.

name: MDF Forest Animal Wall Art – 5 Piece Set
description: Charming forest animal wall art set featuring 5 laser-cut 3mm MDF silhouettes: bear, fox, deer, owl, and squirrel. Each piece is painted in natural wood tones and ready to hang. Creates a stunning woodland gallery wall for nurseries and kids' rooms.

name: MDF Mandala Coaster Set – 4 Piece
description: Exquisite mandala coaster set with 4 laser-cut 3mm MDF coasters featuring intricate geometric patterns. The detailed cutouts create beautiful shadow effects on your table. Sealed with food-safe finish. Each coaster 10cm diameter with cork backing.

name: MDF Botanical Wall Art – 3 Piece Leaf Set
description: Elegant botanical wall art set with 3 laser-cut 3mm MDF leaf designs: monstera, palm, and fern. Each leaf features intricate vein details cut with precision laser technology. Pre-finished in matte white for a modern Scandinavian look. Sizes range from 20-30cm.

name: MDF Geometric Ornament Set – 6 Piece Holiday Collection
description: Modern geometric ornament set with 6 laser-cut 3mm MDF shapes including diamond, sphere frame, cube outline, octahedron, tetrahedron, and icosahedron. Each ornament includes a gold hanging cord. Perfect for minimalist holiday decor or year-round styling.

name: MDF Arabic Calligraphy Wall Art – Bismillah
description: Stunning Arabic calligraphy wall art laser-cut from 3mm MDF. Features the word 'Bismillah' in elegant Thuluth script with decorative border frame. Precision laser cutting captures every delicate curve. Available in gold, black, or white finish. Dimensions: 25cm x 15cm.

name: MDF Honeycomb Shelf Set – 3 Piece Wall Display
description: Trendy honeycomb shelf set with 3 hexagonal laser-cut 3mm MDF frames. Arrange in any configuration to create a unique wall display. Perfect for displaying small plants, photos, and trinkets. Easy wall mounting with included hardware. Each hexagon 15cm across.

name: MDF Leaf Coaster Set – 6 Piece Botanical
description: Nature-inspired coaster set with 6 laser-cut 3mm MDF leaf shapes including oak, maple, eucalyptus, palm, monstera, and ginkgo. Each leaf is uniquely shaped and sealed with a waterproof coating. Organic shapes add a natural touch to any table setting.

name: MDF Moon Phase Wall Hanging – 7 Piece Set
description: Celestial moon phase wall hanging with 7 laser-cut 3mm MDF moon shapes from new moon to full moon and back. Connected with natural jute twine on a wooden dowel. Bohemian decor piece perfect for bedrooms and meditation spaces. Total width: 60cm.

name: MDF Personalized Name Ornament – Custom Cut
description: Beautifully personalized name ornament laser-cut from 3mm MDF in your choice of script font. Perfect as a door hanger, nursery decoration, or gift tag. Custom cut to order with up to 12 characters. Includes ribbon for hanging. Approximate height: 15cm.

name: MDF Spice Jar Label Set – 30 Piece Kitchen Organizer
description: Organize your kitchen with this set of 30 laser-cut 3mm MDF spice jar labels. Each oval label is engraved with common spice names in elegant typography. Self-adhesive backing for easy application. Fits standard spice jar sizes. Includes blank labels for custom spices.

name: MDF Counting & ABC Learning Board – Educational Toy
description: Comprehensive learning board with 36 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces. Features 26 alphabet letters and 10 numbered tiles that slot into a beautifully designed base board. Double-sided: letters on one side, numbers on the other. Develops literacy and numeracy skills. Board: 35cm x 25cm.

name: MDF 3D City Building Set – Premium Construction Kit
description: Amazing 3D city building set with 40+ laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces. Construct houses, a school, a hospital, trees, cars, and road sections into a complete miniature city. Interlocking design requires no glue. Develops engineering thinking and spatial awareness. Finished city fits on a tabletop.

name: MDF Shape Sorter Puzzle – Toddler Educational Toy
description: Classic shape sorting toy reimagined in laser-cut 3mm MDF. Features a sturdy base board with cutouts for 8 different shapes: circle, square, triangle, heart, star, hexagon, diamond, and cross. Each shape is colored for matching. Perfect for ages 2-4 developing fine motor skills.

name: MDF Marble Run Contraption – STEM Building Set
description: Exciting STEM marble run set with 30 laser-cut 3mm MDF tracks, ramps, funnels, and supports. Build endless marble run configurations and watch marbles race through your creation. Develops physics understanding, problem-solving, and engineering skills. Includes 5 glass marbles.

name: MDF Tangram Puzzle Set – Classic Brain Teaser
description: Traditional tangram puzzle made from premium laser-cut 3mm MDF. Includes 7 tangram pieces in vibrant colors that fit into a square base tray. Comes with 20 pattern cards showing different shapes to create: animals, people, vehicles, and more. Develops geometry and spatial reasoning.

name: Geometric Shape Learning Cards – MDF Educational Set
description: Hands-on geometry learning set with 10 laser-cut 3mm MDF shape cards and matching wooden pieces. Children explore shapes like star, rectangle, trapezoid, polygon, hexagon, triangle, circle, heart, square, and octagon through play. Perfect for Montessori classrooms and homeschooling.

name: MDF Fish Number Puzzle – 12 Piece Educational Toy
description: Engaging fish-shaped number puzzle with 12 laser-cut 3mm MDF pieces numbered 0-10. Children learn counting and number sequencing while developing fine motor skills. Each piece has a unique jigsaw interlock. Natural wood finish ready for painting. Assembled size: 25cm x 12cm.

name: MDF Tree of Life Wall Art – 3mm Laser Cut
description: Elegant laser-cut 3mm MDF Tree of Life wall art featuring an intricate silhouette of branches, trunk, and roots. A timeless decorative piece for living rooms, bedrooms, or meditation spaces. Natural wood finish ready for painting, staining, or leaving as-is. Size: 30cm x 40cm.

name: MDF Alphabet Puzzle – Educational Learning Toy
description: Classic alphabet learning set with 26 laser-cut 3mm MDF letter pieces (A-Z). Each uppercase letter is a simple flat cutout made from natural MDF. Perfect for teaching letter recognition, phonics, and early literacy. Ideal for classrooms, homeschooling, and preschool play. Natural wood finish ready for painting.
